audience: fitness, yoga, pilates and wellness studios that run classes and memberships in TimetableOS

useCases.title: Find memberships that are past due
useCases.text: List the memberships by status. Then list the invoices to see what each member owes.

useCases.title: Check the spots left in a class
useCases.text: List the sessions of the classes in a time window. Read one session for its capacity and spots left.

useCases.title: Book a member into a class
useCases.text: Read the session and the member. Then book the member. The front desk rules apply, and a visit that needs payment is refused.

useCases.title: Capture a website enquiry as a lead
useCases.text: Capture the enquiry as a lead, the same way the studio's website form does.
